saadway-credentials.description: Dashboard credential management (constitution v1.1.0, Principle V — the single bounded exception to the strict dual-UI decoupling: the LuCI panel may manage the STANDALONE DASHBOARD's own login credential). Grants exactly one ubus method; the change is applied by the root-only provisioning helper (the secret is piped to the platform's passwd, never stored by the daemon). This group is deliberately NOT part of the dashboard's own 'saadway' group (saadway/files/rpc-acl.json), so a standalone-dashboard session can never re-key its own login (FR-034). Only the router's stock root session obtains it (login group '*').
